beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This selective construction must operate within explicit limits on time and resources.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The difficult question is choosing useful work without exploring every possible combination.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book makes that construction problem central rather than hiding it behind expressiveness.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: One of the book’s strongest organizing ideas is the separation of two timescales.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Slow acquisition can use creative, expensive, partly neural processes.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A coding agent may propose commands, tests, templates, and interpretations of documents.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Fast execution uses reviewed capabilities under declared versions and work budgets.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A request must not silently install the capability it has just invented.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: New proposals enter a separate process before promotion into reusable knowledge.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The architecture lets readers ask where experimentation belongs and where stable commitments must begin.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Imagine a search returning no supporting evidence before its time budget expires.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That outcome is not equivalent to proving that supporting evidence does not exist.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The circuit should expose what it examined and where exploration stopped.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Unsupported input, unresolved alternatives, and missing knowledge also require distinguishable outcomes.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book treats abstention as an essential capability of bounded reasoning.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A useful receipt makes the frontier of the search inspectable.
